senses.gloss: उप-धमन See उप-√ ध्मा.
उप-धमन n. the act of blowing at, blowing, Gaut. ix, 32.
उप-धर्म m. a minor or subordinate duty
a by-law, Mn. ii, 237; iv, 147
a false faith, heresy, BhP.
2. उप-धा f. imposition, forgery, fraud, deceit, trick, false pretence, MBh.; Mn.; R.
trial or test of honesty (of four kinds, viz. of loyalty, disinterestedness, continence, and courage), Kām.; Bhaṭṭ.; Śiś. &c.
(in Gr.) a penultimate letter, Pāṇ.; RPrāt.; APrāt.; Nir. &c.
condition, reservation, L.
उप-धा—भृत m. a kind of servant (engaged under particular conditions), L.
उप-धा—लोप m. elision of the penultimate letter.
उप-धा—˚लोपिन् mfn. subject to the above (as a Bahuvrīhi compound ending in अन्), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 28.
उप-धा—शुचि mfn. of approved virtue, approved, tried, Hit.
उप-धा॑न mfn. placing upon, employed or used in placing upon (as a Mantra in the setting up of the sacrificial bricks), Pāṇ. iv, 4, 125
उप-धा॑न n. the act of placing or resting upon, KātyŚr.; Kauś.
that on which one rests, a pillow, cushion, AV. xiv, 2, 65; ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
cover, lid, Car.; Hcat.
peculiarity, singularity, excellence (cf. प्रेमोप˚), Bālar.; Siddh.
affection, kindness
religious observance
poison, L.
(also) fetching, procuring, Jātakam.
a jewel-case, ib.
उप-धा॑नी f. a pillow, cushion
footstool (see पादोप˚), MBh.
उप-धान—विधि m. N. of wk.
उप-धान—लिङ्ग mfn. (a verse) containing the word उप-धान, ĀpGṛ.
उपधानक n. a pillow, cushion, Hcat.
उप-धानीय mfn. to be put under
उप-धानीय n. a pillow, cushion, Pañcat.
उप-धाय ind.p. having placed or rested upon &c.
उपा-धा॑य ind.p. taking up or with, together with, ŚBr. iv.
उप-धायिन् mfn. ifc. placing under, Kum.
उप-धि॑ इस्, m. the act of putting to, adding, addition, Lāṭy.
the part of the wheel between the nave and the circumference, RV. ii, 39, 4; AV. vi, 70, 3; Kāṭh.
fraud, circumvention, MBh.; R.; Yājñ.; Kir. &c.
condition
peculiarity, attribute (Buddh.; see उपा-धि)
one of the requisites for the equipment of a Jaina ascetic (said to be 6, viz. 3 garments, 1 jar, 1 broom, and 1 screen for the mouth), Śīl.
support, MW.
उप-धि॑ See p. 199, col. 3.
1. उपा-धि m. (for 2. See s.v.) that which is put in the place of another thing, a substitute, substitution, R.

anything which may be taken for or has the mere name or appearance of another thing, appearance, phantom, disguise (said to be applied to certain forms or properties considered as disguises of the spirit, W.), Prab.; Bhāṣāp.; Sāh. &c.
anything defining more closely, a peculiarity
an attribute (अस्त्य्-उपाधि, having ‘is’ as an attribute)
title, discriminative appellation, nickname
limitation, qualification (e.g. अन्-उपाधि-रामणीय, beautiful without limitation, i.e. altogether beautiful)
(in log.) a qualifying term added to a too general middle term to prevent ativyāpti
that which is placed under, supposition, condition, postulate, Sarvad.; Vedāntas.; Tarkas.; BhP. &c.
deception, deceit, MBh. iii, 13017
species.
2. उपा-धि m. (for 1. See col. 2) (√ ध्यै), point of view, aim, Car.
reflection on duty, virtuous reflection, L.
a man who is careful to support his family, L.
उपधिक m. a cheat, knave (especially one who imposes by threats), Mn. ix, 258
(Kull. reads औपधिक, and probably चौपधिका is to be read for चोपधिका in the text.)
उपाधिक mfn. exceeding, supernumerary.
उप-धेय mfn. to be placed upon, being placed upon.

उप-धातु m. a secondary mineral, semi-metal (seven are specified: स्वर्ण-माक्षिक, pyrites; तार-माक्षिक, a particular white mineral; तुत्थ, sulphate of copper; कांस्य, brass; रीति, calx of brass; सिन्दूर, red lead; शिलाजतु, red chalk), Bhpr.
secondary secretions and constituents of the body (viz. the milk, menses, adeps, sweat, teeth, hair, and lymph), ŚārṅgS. &c.
उप-धारण See उप-√ धृ.
उप-धारण n. the act of considering, consideration, reflection, MBh.

उपा-√ धाव् P. -धावति, to run towards, BhP. :
Caus. -धावयति, to carry or convey towards, ŚBr. x.
उप-धावन m. a follower, W.
उप-धूपित mfn. fumigated, enveloped in smoke, MBh.; R.
near death, dying, L.
उप-धूपिता f. (scil. दिश्) = the next.

उप-धूमिता f. (scil. दिश्, fr. उपधूमय), ‘enveloped in haze’, the quarter of the heavens to which the sun is proceeding (opposed to दग्धा, दीप्ता, and the five शान्ता), Vasantarāja, T. (cf. प्र-धूमित, सं-धू˚.)
1. उप-धार्य mfn. to be comprehended, Car.
2. उप-धार्य ind.p. having taken or held up &c.
उप-धृति f. a ray of light, L.
उप-√ धृष् P. (pf. -दधर्ष) to venture to undertake, ŚBr. ix, 5, 2, 1.
उप-√ धे Caus. Ā. (3. du. -धापयेते) to suckle, rear by suckling, RV. i, 95, 1.
उपधेनु ind. near the cows, Kir.
1. उप-√ ध्मा P. -ध॑मति, to blow or breathe at or upon, RV. v, 9, 5; ŚBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.; ṢaḍvBr.; MānŚr.; Mn.
2. उप-ध्मा f. id.
the effort of the voice which produces the sound उपध्मानीय.
उपा-√ ध्मा P. (aor. -अध्मासीत्) to blow into, MBh.; Hariv.
उप-ध्मा॑न mf(ई)n. breathing or blowing upon, AV. viii, 8, 2.
उप-ध्मानीय m. the Visarga (q.v.) as pronounced before the letters प् and फ्, Pāṇ.; VPrāt. &c.
उप-√ ध्यै
उप-ध्यात mfn. remembered, thought of MBh.
उप-√ ध्वंस् Pass. -ध्वस्यते, to be afflicted or attacked, Suśr.
उप-ध्वस्त॑ mfn. speckled, spotted, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; KātyŚr. (cf. ध्वस्त.)
उपाधाय्य-पूर्वय mfn., ‘having an edge or border’ (of braid), trimmed, edged, TS.
see पूर्वय, p. 645.
उपा-धि—खण्डन n. N. of wk.
उपा-धि—तस् ind. in consequence of any qualification or condition.
उपा-धि—दूषकता-बीज n. N. of wk.
उपा-धि—न्यायसंग्रह m. N. of wk.
उपा-धि—मात्रायाम् ind. for the sake of mere appearance, Kauś.
उपा-धि—विवृति f.
उपा-धि—सिद्धान्त-ग्रन्थ m. N. of works.
उपाधि-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to ascend or mount up to, ŚBr. iii, vi.

उपाध्य्-आय m. (√ इ), a teacher, preceptor (who subsists by teaching a part of the Veda or Vedāṅgas, grammar &c.; he is distinguished from the Ācārya q.v.), Mn. iv, 141, &c.; Yājñ. i, 35; MBh.; Śak. &c.
उपाध्य्-आय f(आ or ई) a female teacher, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iii, 13, 21
उपाध्य्-आयी f. the wife of a teacher, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49.
उपाध्य्-आय—सर्वस्व n. N. of a grammar (frequently referred to by the Comm. on Uṇ.)
उपाध्यायानी f. the wife of a teacher, Kāty. on Pāṇ. iv, 1, 49.
उपाध्यायी-√ 1. कृ to choose as teacher, appoint as teacher, Bālar.; N.
उपाध्वर्यु m. a second Adhvaryu (in place of the true Adhvaryu), MBh. xiii.
